Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:11:1.hebrew: לפי שאינו דומה חבר שקיבל - הוא עצמו לבן חבר מחמת קבלת אביו, שאין לו שום קבלה אלא סרך אביו, דודאי אביו מיזדהר טפי. ל"א: האי "לפי שאינו דומה", תנא קמא קאמר ליה: מה טעם בניו ובני ביתו אין צריכין לקבל? לפי שאינו דומה חבר שקיבל לבן חבר שקיבל אביו, דבן חבר לא חשיד. ובתוספתא גרסינן: "שאין דומה חבר שקלקל לבן חבר שקלקל", במסכת דמאי:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:11:1.english: Because a ḥaver who accepted is not comparable - [That is, one who accepted] himself [is not comparable] to the son of a ḥaver [who has that status merely] by virtue of his father’s acceptance, who has no acceptance [of his own] other than following his father’s habit; for certainly his father is more careful. Another explanation: This [clause], “Because [a ḥaver who accepted] is not comparable,” the first tanna states it: What is the reason [that] his children and the members of his household do not need to accept? Because a ḥaver who accepted [himself] is not comparable to the son of a ḥaver whose father accepted, for the son of a ḥaver is not suspected. And in the Tosefta in tractate Demai, we have the reading: “For a ḥaver who corrupted [his ways] is not comparable to the son of a ḥaver who corrupted [his ways].”

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:13:1.hebrew: נשנית משנה זו - דאפי' תלמיד חכם צריך לקבל:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:13:1.english: This mishna was taught - That even a Torah scholar must accept [the obligations of fellowship].

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:13:2.hebrew: בטהרות - בסדר טהרות לא גרסי'. בטהרות עצמן אירע להן מעשה, ונסתפקה הלכה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:13:2.english: Regarding ritual purity - We do not read: "In the Order of Tohorot." [Rather,] an incident occurred to them involving actual ritually pure items, and the halakha became uncertain.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:13:3.english: They sent Rabbis - They sent a pair of Rabbis.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:13:4.hebrew: אותיב רבנן מדידיה - מתלמידיו שקיבלו עליהן דברי חבירות אותיב בהדי הנך שלוחים, וקאי איהו לעיוני בשאילתם:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:13:4.english: He seated Sages of his own - From his students who had accepted upon themselves the rules of ḥaverut [fellowship], he seated [them] with those messengers, and he stood to examine their inquiry.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:14:1.hebrew: אבא של זה כו' - אגב ריתחיה קאמר, ולא היא:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:14:1.english: This one’s father, etc. - He said [this] out of his anger, but it is not so:

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:15:1.english: The honor of the elder - [Both] the father and the son.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:15:2.hebrew: סילסול - מעלה. ר' חנינא בן אנטיגנוס כהן היה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:15:2.english: A higher standard - [A mark of] distinction. Rabbi Ḥanina ben Antigonus was a priest.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:16:1.english: [It retains] its presumptive status until it is disqualified - That they sell in it indigo [kala ilan] as sky-blue dye [tekhelet].

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:17:1.hebrew: צריכין לקבל דברי חבירות בתחלה גרסי', ולא גרסי' כבתחלה - ובתוספתא גרסינן הכי: בבתחלה, כלומר: מתחלה, קודם שנחזיקנו בחבירות. ואע"ג דאמרן לעיל בניו ובני ביתו אין צריכין לקבל — הכא שאני, הואיל ובשעת קבלה לא הוו גביה, ואיכא למימר דסרכייהו קמא נקטי:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:17:1.english: “They must accept the matters of ḥaver status initially” we read, and we do not read “as at first” - And in the Tosefta we read this: “Bivteḥilah” [at the beginning] — that is to say, from the outset, before we presume him to have ḥaver status. And even though we said earlier [that] his sons and the members of his household do not need to accept [the obligations of a ḥaver], here it is different, since at the time of [his] acceptance they were not with him, and it can be said that they maintain their former habit.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:17:2.english: They need not accept - If they returned under the authority of a ḥaver.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:18:2.hebrew: קשרי מוכס - שיש חותמות למוכסים, וכשנותנין להן המכס, הם נותנין לו חותם, כדי שלא יתבענו מוכס שני:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:18:2.english: Knots of a tax collector - For tax collectors have seals, and when [people] pay them the tax, they give him a seal so that a second tax collector will not demand [payment] from him.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:1:1.hebrew: חשוד על המעשר חשוד על השביעית - וכ"ש חשוד אשביעית, חשוד אמעשר:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:1:1.english: [One who is] suspect with regard to tithe [is] suspect with regard to the Sabbatical Year - And all the more so, [one who is] suspect with regard to the Sabbatical Year is suspect with regard to tithe.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:1:2.hebrew: ומאן חכמים ר' מאיר - דאמר לקמן: חשוד לדבר אחד, חשוד לכל התורה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:1:2.english: And who are the Rabbis? Rabbi Meir - For he says later on: One who is suspect with regard to one matter is suspect with regard to the entire Torah.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:3:1.hebrew: הרי הוא כישראל מומר - ולא אמרינן דליהוי עובד כוכבים גמור, כאילו לא נתגייר:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:3:1.english: He is like an apostate Jew - And we do not say that he should be [considered] a complete gentile, as though he had never converted.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:3:2.hebrew: דאי קדיש - אשה לאחר שהמיר דתו, קידושיו קידושין:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:3:2.english: That if he betroths - [If he betroths] a woman after he apostatized, his betrothal is a [valid] betrothal.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:4:1.hebrew: דברי חבירות - מפרש בתוספתא במסכת דמאי: שלא יתן תרומה ומעשר לעם הארץ, ושלא יעשה טהרות אצל עם הארץ, ושיאכל חולין בטהרה, ושיעשר את שהוא אוכל, ואת שהוא מוכר, ואת שהוא לוקח:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:4:1.english: The matters of ḥaver status - It is explained in the Tosefta in Tractate Demai: that he may not give terumah and tithes to an am ha’aretz, and that he may not prepare ritually pure foods with an am ha’aretz, and that he must eat non-sacred food in a state of ritual purity, and that he must tithe what he eats, what he sells, and what he buys.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:4:2.english: Minutiae of the Scribes - A rabbinic stringency.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:5:1.hebrew: דברי לויה - לשורר, ולשרת, ולהיות שוער:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:5:1.english: The matters of a Levite - To sing, and to serve, and to be a gatekeeper.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:5:2.hebrew: מבני אהרן - משמע שיהא נוהג כל דין בני אהרן — לו תהיה שוק הימין למנה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:5:2.english: From the sons of Aaron - [This] implies that [only if] he observes every law of the sons of Aaron, “to him shall be the right thigh for a portion.”

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:6:1.hebrew: שנוהג בצינעה - קודם שקיבל בפנינו היה נוהג עליו דין חבירות, שאין לחושדו ולומר: לפנים הוא עושה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:6:1.english: That he practices in private - Before he accepted [the obligations of ḥaver status] before us, he was [already] observing upon himself the laws of ḥaver status, so that there is no [reason] to suspect him and say: “He is [only] doing [this] for show.”

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:6:2.english: He is accepted - That we regard him as a ḥaver and as trustworthy in all his statements.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:7:1.hebrew: לכנפים - שיטול ידיו קודם אכילה, וקודם שיגע באוכלין דתרומה, דידים שניות הן:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:7:1.english: For "wings" - That he wash his hands prior to eating, and prior to touching food of terumah, for [unwashed] hands are [rabbinically decreed to be] second-degree [sources of ritual impurity].

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:7:2.hebrew: לטהרות - לחומר שאר טהרות, ונחזיק טהרותיו כטהרות גמורות, לאכול תרומתו כתרומה טהורה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:7:2.english: For purities - For the stringency of the other purities, and we presume his pure items to be completely pure, to eat his teruma as pure teruma.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:7:3.hebrew: מקבלין אותו - דאינו משייר דבר שלם, שהרי מקבל עליו נטילת ידים, וזהו עיקר אכילת חולין בטהרה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:7:3.english: He is accepted - For he is not omitting a complete matter, as he accepts upon himself the washing of hands, and this is the core of eating non-sacred food in purity.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:7:4.hebrew: אף לטהרות לא קבל - דכיון דבדין נטילת ידים, שדבר קל הוא לעשות, אינו יכול לעמוד — כל שכן בשאר:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:7:4.english: Even for purity he has not accepted - For since regarding the law of washing hands, which is an easy thing to do, he cannot uphold [it], all the more so regarding the rest.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:8:1.hebrew: עד כמה מקבל אותו - דברי חבירות, שנקבלנו לאלתר ונחזיקנו בחבר:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:8:1.english: For how long is he accepted - [With regard to] matters of ḥaverut, so that we accept him immediately and presume him to be a ḥaver.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:8:2.hebrew: למשקין שלשים יום - שאם קיבל עליו דברי חבירות, עד שלשים יום — מהמנינן ליה מכאן ואילך בטהרות משקין, שטומאתן קלה, דטומאת משקין מדרבנן, בפ' קמא דפסחים (דף טז:):
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:8:2.english: With regard to liquids, thirty days - That if he accepted upon himself the obligations of ḥaverut, [and waited] until thirty days [have passed], we believe him from that point forward regarding the purity of liquids, as their impurity is light, for the impurity of liquids is rabbinic, [as stated] in the first chapter of Pesachim (daf 16b).

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:8:3.hebrew: לכסות - להחזיק כסותו כחבר, דאמר במסכת חגיגה (דף יח:): בגדי עם הארץ מדרס לפרושים:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:8:3.english: With regard to clothing - To treat his clothing as [that of] a ḥaver, as it is stated in Tractate Chagigah (18b): “The garments of an am ha’aretz are [considered] midras for perushim.”

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:8:4.english: Twelve months - If he accepted upon himself the obligations of ḥaverut for twelve months.

Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:9:1.hebrew: הוה ליה מקולי בית שמאי ומחומרי בית הלל - וליתנייה גבי קולי בית שמאי וחומרי בית הלל במסכת עדיות (פ"ה מ"א), דאמרינן: ששה דברים מקולי בית שמאי ומחומרי בית הילל, ואם איתא — ליתני הא. ל"א: עד כמה מקבלין אותו — דאמרן לעיל: אם נהג מתחלה בצינעא בתוך ביתו מקבלין אותו מיד; ועד כמה ינהג מתחלה שנקבלנו מיד:
Rashi on Bekhorot 30b:9:1.english: This is [one] of the leniencies of Beit Shammai and of the stringencies of Beit Hillel - Then let it be taught among the leniencies of Beit Shammai and the stringencies of Beit Hillel in tractate Eduyyot (5:1), where we say: "Six matters are of the leniencies of Beit Shammai and of the stringencies of Beit Hillel" — and if it is so, let it teach this [as well]. Another explanation: "Until when is he accepted" — as we said earlier, if he initially conducted himself in private within his house, we accept him immediately; and for how long must he initially conduct himself so that we accept him immediately?

Tosafot on Bekhorot 30b:14:1.english: "This one’s father degraded our students" - [He degraded them] regarding matters of ritual purity, just as his son did.

Tosafot on Bekhorot 30b:2:1.hebrew: וחכמים אומרים אינו נחשד אלא על אותו דבר בלבד - לר' אילעאי דלעיל, דחשוד על הטהרות חשוד על השביעית אלא היכא שראינוהו נוהג בצינעא — הא דקאמר הכא "אינו נאסר אלא לאותו דבר" לאו דוקא, אלא לאותו דבר וכיוצא בו; ולא אתא אלא לאפוקי בכל התורה כולה:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 30b:2:1.english: "And the Rabbis say: He is suspected only with regard to that particular matter" - According to Rabbi Ilai above, [who holds] that one who is suspect with regard to ritual purity is suspect with regard to the Sabbatical Year, except where we saw him conduct himself [stringently] in private — that which [the baraita] states here, "he is prohibited only with regard to that matter," is not exact; rather, [it means] with regard to that matter and what is similar to it, and it came only to exclude [being suspected with regard to] the entire Torah.
